Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk

Class BulkProtocolReader<WI,ID>

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk.BulkProtocolReader<WI,ID>
public final class BulkProtocolReader<WI,ID> extends Object
Isolated, bounded entry point for the bulk wire protocol. It validates original JSON tokens before a host mapper can coerce identifiers. It never changes the application's ObjectMapper. Domain parameter/filter readers must bind and validate their canonical DTOs; authorization, candidate validation, proposal persistence and execution are separate stages.
